title: Bailing Hay Without Burning Down Barns
reason: Describes the process of baling hay to prevent it from spoiling and burning.

tasks.task: Describing the hay baling process to prevent combustion and spoilage.

subtasks.text: Fuelling the tractor before starting the hay cutting process.
Cutting 13-foot paths in the hay field, despite the upcoming rain.
Broadcasting the hay to spread it out for maximum drying.
Using a rotary rake to help dry the hay more efficiently.
Applying dry hay inoculant to the hay while baling.
Waiting until late afternoon to bale the hay for ideal drying conditions.

tasks.task: Moving the bales to prevent combustion and further drying.

subtasks.text: Starting to move the bales as soon as they are baled.
Keeping bales spread out with air gaps to prevent moisture-related issues.
